name: Talon
notes: Talon opens with Shadow Assault (R) at t=0: its outward blade pass hits immediately, and it recasts (converges) as soon as its 0.8 s minimum lifetime elapses, dealing the same damage a second time, then goes on cooldown and repeats this cycle for the rest of the fight.

Noxian Diplomacy (Q) is always cast from close range, since Talon spends the whole fight in melee range of the stationary dummy: this gives its guaranteed critical strike (the wiki's stated 97.5-217.5 base, +150% bonus AD figures, used as-is rather than separately re-multiplying by the build's crit damage stat, since the ability's own 150% multiplier is not the champion's normal crit multiplier). The resulting cast-time delay to the next attack is modeled with the engine's standard 0.25 s cast lockout, matching how the reference driver treats Jax's Leap Strike rather than tracking the true windup-length cast time.

Rake (W) is cast on cooldown: the outgoing dagger pass lands as the cast starts and keeps Talon busy for its stated 0.25 s cast time (gen.W.castTimeS), during which no other cast or attack can start; after the 0.7 s return delay the homing return pass lands as its own event. Both passes are assumed to hit the stationary target, matching the wiki's 'Total' damage figures.

Blade's End (P) stacks Wound on every ability hit that connects (Q's single hit; both passes of Rake and Shadow Assault), capping at 3 stacks and refreshing its 6 s duration whenever a basic attack lands while stacks are up. Once a basic attack lands with 3 stacks up, it is treated as the empowered attack: it consumes the stacks and starts a 2 s, 16-tick (0.125 s/tick) bleed for the passive's total damage, during which the target cannot gain new Wound stacks, per the wiki wording.
Noxian Diplomacy's kill-triggered heal, 50% cooldown refund, and bonus attack-range grant are not modeled: the stat dummy never dies in these fights and the range grant has no damage effect.
Mana costs on Q/W/R are not modeled: none of them bind Talon's rotation within a 15 s fight at level 16.
Assassin's Path (E) is pure mobility with no damage and is never cast in the fight; it is left last in the leveling order since it contributes nothing here.
